Subject: Request: IRP and artifacts after auth anomaly (June 15)

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick support on the outage yesterday. FinTrust's security team is doing a post-incident compliance check and we need the following to complete our SIG/SOC2 evidence package:

- A redacted copy of your Incident Response Plan (runbook) or pointer to the internal runbook we can reference in an SOC2 attestation.
- A sanitized postmortem covering detection, root cause summary, and remediation steps (suitable for sharing with auditors).
- Telemetry exports (auth logs, token issuance, and relevant request traces) for 2028-06-14 to 2028-06-16.
- A short note describing your redaction policy (what fields are removed/hashed) and retention window for shared artifacts.

We may need an NDA or DPA addendum to accept raw logs — can your team advise on that? Also please confirm approximate delivery ETA; our audit window closes 2028-06-25.

Appreciate it — Amira
Amira Hassan
Security Manager, FinTrust Bank

Kimberly / Amira — drafting the delivery plan below. Reply inline where you want changes.

Delivery plan (proposed):
1) Redacted IRP runbook (remove internal IPs, some nonessential playbook step text that includes on-call numbers). File: IRP_Redacted_20280622.pdf.
2) Sanitized postmortem (timeline, root cause, corrective actions, verification steps). File: postmortem_sanitized.md.
3) Telemetry export: auth logs and token service traces for 2028-06-14 -> 2028-06-16. We will provide a redacted .zip where user identifiers are hashed and IPs truncated. File: telemetry_export_20280615.zip.
4) Delegation matrix/contacts for the incident (redacted emails). File: delegation_matrix.csv.

Redaction approach: user IDs hashed with per-transfer salt; IPs truncated to /24; session tokens redacted entirely. We will include a short manifest describing each transform. Retention: FinTrust may keep artifacts for 30 days; longer retention requires explicit agreement and a named business justification.

Transfer method: Secure Google Drive share (restricted link + viewer expiration) is fine for redacted items. If you request raw, unredacted logs, we require a signed NDA and will use our SFTP with time-limited credentials.

ETA: Drafts available 2028-06-21 for internal review, final delivery 2028-06-22.

Amira — does FinTrust need a CAIQ/SIG crosswalk mapping? We can include a one-page mapping of the IRP sections to SIG/CAIQ control IDs.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Security Engineer, Incident Response

- For the telemetry export, FinTrust is prepared to sign a limited NDA to receive unredacted logs if that helps with our internal forensics; please send DocuSign envelope and required scoping language.

HubSpot ticket for our procurement/audit team: HUBSPOT-123456 — I'll reference that when we accept the drive link.

Thanks again. If you can confirm final delivery method (Drive link + viewer expiry) and include the crosswalk, we'll schedule a short verification call next week.
